description: HIGHWAY OFFICIAL is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Government of Saskatchewan | Gouvernement de la Saskatchewan. HIGHWAYOFFICIAL provides the LRS based geospatial information of Provincial and National Highways System in Saskatchewan. It is one of the base layer used to create "Roadseg" layer for Saskatchewan Upgraded Road Network (SURN) and National Road Network (NRN). Coverage: Government of Saskatchewan. The portal files it under the publisher Government of Saskatchewan | Gouvernement de la Saskatchewan. Its tags are Transportation, Infrastructure, Road Network, Highway, transportation. It offers 12 resource(s) in CSV, ESRI REST, GDB, GEOJSON, GPKG. The portal shows 2025-10-15 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Government of Saskatchewan Standard Unrestricted Use Data License (Version 2.0). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
